title: Agent to server: snapshot (1 to 2 Hz)

state.description: iRacing session state, for example Racing.

track.description: The layout being raced, from the session info's WeekendInfo (agent 0.8 and newer; absent when the agent cannot tell). id is iRacing's TrackID, one per layout, the key for race control's track maps.

name.description: WeekendInfo.TrackDisplayName, for example Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez.

config.description: WeekendInfo.TrackConfigName, for example Grand Prix; empty for a track with one layout.

sectorStarts.description: SplitTimeInfo: where the layout's sectors start, as lap distance, in sector order (the first is 0, the line). The sector numbers of sector_crossings events index this list. Optional (agent 0.9 and newer).

laps.description: A session limited by laps (SessionLapsTotal; left out when unlimited, iRacing's 32767). remaining is SessionLapsRemainEx: the leader's current lap is total - remaining + 1 (session and weather check, 2026-11-03). Optional (agent 0.10 and newer).

time.description: A session limited by time (SessionTimeTotal below a day; iRacing has no single value for unlimited, a lap race showed 86400). remainingSec is SessionTimeRemain; after the checkered flag it counts the cool-down. Optional (agent 0.10 and newer).

weather.description: The weather now, from telemetry (race control's weather card, spec-feedback 40). Optional (agent 0.10 and newer).

wetness.description: TrackWetness 1 to 7; left out at 0 (unknown, seen for a moment at a session change).

declaredWet.description: WeatherDeclaredWet: the session is declared wet (wet tyres allowed).

windDirDeg.description: WindDir as degrees, the direction the wind comes from, 0 north, clockwise.

classes.description: The car classes in the session, one item per class id the cars carry (the pace car's class left out), from the session info's DriverInfo.Drivers (spec-feedback 44). The agent forwards iRacing's values; the server decides the names shown. Optional (agent 0.12 and newer).

name.description: CarClassShortName, trimmed; left out when empty (empty in AI sessions, class names check 2026-11-04).

colour.description: CarClassColor (0xrrggbb in the session info) as #rrggbb; left out when iRacing gives none.

models.description: The class's car models in the session (CarScreenName); left out when iRacing names none.

flags.description: Session-wide flags, normalised by the agent (see common.schema.json flagName). Per-car flags such as black or blue are not listed here.

surface.description: For example OnTrack, OffTrack, InPitStall, NotInWorld.

flags.description: Per-car flags, normalised by the agent from CarIdxSessionFlags and CarIdxPaceFlags (spike 3): black (a black flag to serve), disqualify, waved_around, end_of_line. Optional; an agent that does not send it says nothing about them. The server marks a black-flag penalty served when black clears without its own !clear.

lastLapTime.description: CarIdxLastLapTime in seconds: iRacing's time for the car's last lap. Absent while iRacing has none (-1: before the first lap, an in-lap, a lap under a black flag). It changes up to about a second after the car crosses the line (lap times check, 2026-11-02). Optional (agent 0.9 and newer).

bestLapTime.description: CarIdxBestLapTime in seconds: the car's fastest lap in this session as iRacing timed it. Absent without one. Optional (agent 0.9 and newer).
